QuestInfo.name: The Continental Conference
QuestInfo.0: Empress #p1101000# is shocked by the report from the Gate to the Future. Help her decide what she must do next.
QuestInfo.1: Empress #p1101000# realizes that the Cygnus Knights can't protect Maple World on their own. She is calling for an Alliance between all the people of Maple World. Deliver her message to #p1101002#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# will need your help executing #p1101000#'s plans.

0.0: I'm sorry. I'll try to pull myself together. I consider myself blessed to have such a worthy knight as you by my side, #h0#.
0.1: The Cygnus Knights have always tried to fight off the shadow of the Black Mage without seeking the help of others. After all, I believed that we had to be stand by our own power.
0.2: But now I realize that we can't stop the Black Mage on our own. I am weak, and I see now that the world won't always be able to rely on us. We need help.
0.3: This won't be easy. There are plenty of people who will be against us. Few will trust us, and many will refuse to help. However, I see no other way. Please tell #p1101002# that I've made my decision.

yes.0: We will hold a continental conference. Its purpose: To form an Alliance to unite Maple World.

1.0: The Empress has made her decision? She was worried that the idea of an alliance might make us some enemies...
1.1: The Black Mage won't be easy to defeat. It is only by standing together that Maple World has a chance of survival.
1.2: The Empress's decision is to step down from the comforts of Ereve and onto the battlefield to fight.

yes.0: There are many preparations to be made. I trust that you will assist me.

npc.0: I can't say if this is the right decision, but this is no time to second guess ourselves. We must simply try to do what is right.
